metadata.summary: PMC-Patients is a large-scale dataset of 167,000 patient summaries automatically extracted from PubMed Central (PMC) full-text articles. Each record corresponds to a patient described in case reports / studies, with structured fields (demographics, conditions, procedures, etc.) and links to the source article.
metadata.purpose: Supports patient-level retrieval, patient QA, and clinical NLP.
metadata.avoided_uses: Not intended for real-time clinical decision support or direct EHR integration; not representative of real-world clinical practice due to publication bias and lack of outcomes.

papers.title: PMC-Patients: A Large-scale Dataset of Patient Summaries from PubMed Central

modality.scope: General clinical patient narratives (demographics, conditions, procedures)

ethics.license: CC BY 4.0 (per Scientific Data article); individual PMC articles subject to their own copyright/licensing terms.
ethics.privacy_measures: De-identification performed during extraction; however, re-identification risk remains due to rich clinical narrative and source article linkage.
ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with PMC open-access policy; no explicit GDPR/HIPAA applicability as data is literature-derived and de-identified.
ethics.bias_impact_assessment: Publication bias acknowledged as key limitation; no formal bias impact assessment reported.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.

known_limitations: Extracted from publications, not live EHR systems
Lacks structured clinical labels and outcomes
Selection reflects what is publishable (e.g., rare cases, positive results, institutional biases)
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — automated extraction, structuring, and normalization from unstructured PMC text.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Not representative of general patient populations or real-world clinical practice; skewed toward publishable cases.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Highly skewed class distribution reflecting rarity and reporting bias in case literature.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability to real-world clinical settings due to literature origin, language restriction, and absence of longitudinal or outcome data.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Poor coverage of non-English-speaking, low-income, and underrepresented racial/ethnic groups in source literature.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Widespread missingness in structured fields (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity) due to inconsistent reporting in source articles.

benchmarks: PMC-Patients Benchmark (as defined in original paper)
tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Real-time clinical decision support, prognostic modeling, or regulatory use.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Patients described in case reports and clinical studies published in PubMed Central.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Automated extraction from PMC full-text articles containing patient descriptions; no explicit sampling strategy reported beyond inclusion of all identifiable patient summaries meeting structural criteria.
data_origin.aggregation_multisource: Aggregated from heterogeneous PMC articles; no harmonization of demographic or clinical coding reported.
data_origin.data_shifts_overtime: Cohort reflects temporal distribution of PMC publications; potential shifts due to evolving reporting standards, journal policies, and disease prevalence in literature.

population.target_population: Patients described in published biomedical case reports and clinical studies.
population.inclusion_criteria: Patients explicitly described in PMC full-text articles with sufficient demographic/clinical detail for structured extraction.
population.exclusion_criteria: Articles without identifiable patient-level narrative or insufficient structured information.
population.missing_groups: Underrepresentation of non-English-language populations, low-resource settings, and patients from regions with low publication output.

attribute_recording.unknown_proportion: Proportion of missing/unreported demographics and comorbidities not quantified in source.

annotation.annotation_method: NLP-based extraction from PMC full-text using rule-based and heuristic methods to identify and structure patient descriptions.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels derived from unstructured text in PMC articles; no human-verified ground truth provided.
annotation.label_noise_description: Extraction errors due to formatting variability, ambiguous referents, and incomplete narrative structure in source text.
